name: gap_continuation_v1
author: claude-4.6-opus-fast
thesis: When a stock gaps up/down on genuine institutional flow (above-average pre-open volume, gap aligned with sector/index direction), the gap often continues for another 0.5-1.0% as momentum traders pile in and VWAP algorithms begin accumulating. This is the 'gap and go' pattern. The key filter is volume: gaps on 2x+ average volume signal real institutional interest, not retail noise. The inefficiency exists because most traders are either fading the gap (contrarian bias) or waiting too long to enter (confirmation bias), allowing early momentum entrants to capture the continuation move before the crowd arrives. Entering within the first 10 minutes with volume confirmation captures this window.
universe: NIFTY 50 and NIFTY Next 50 on NSE
stock_filter: gap > 0.5% (abs); opening 5-min volume > 2x avg; sector ETF gapping in same direction
session: 09:15-12:00 IST (momentum plays work in morning session)
indicators: rel_strength = gap_pct - NIFTY_gap_pct  # stock gap relative to index

long.confirmation: breakout bar closes in upper 30% of its range (strong close)

short.confirmation: breakdown bar closes in lower 30% of its range (weak close)

entry.entry_price: market order on bar close after breakout/breakdown confirmed

exit.target: 0.7% move from entry in gap direction (continuation target)
exit.stop_loss: close re-enters opening range (below ORH for longs, above ORL for shorts) OR 0.5 * ATR_10
exit.trailing_stop: after 0.3% gain, trail stop at 0.15% below current high (longs) or above current low (shorts)
exit.time_stop: exit if held > 60 mins (morning momentum fades by late morning)
exit.eod_rule: flatten by 12:00 IST (momentum play, don't hold into lunch)
exit.signal_exit: if EMA_5 crosses EMA_13 against position direction, exit

filters.vix_filter: India_VIX > 13 (need some volatility for continuation); VIX < 25 (not chaotic)
filters.time_filter: enter between 09:20-10:15 IST; gap and go works in first hour only
filters.trend_filter: NIFTY futures gapping in same direction as stock (aligned momentum)
filters.event_filter: only trade if gap is NOT due to stock-specific earnings (sector/market-wide momentum is better)
other_filters: skip if opening range is wider than 1.5 * ATR_10 (already extended)

edge.edge_decay_risk: low-moderate — momentum continuation is a well-known pattern but execution timing creates edge

weaknesses: Win rate is below 55% — momentum continuation fails frequently, and the strategy relies on occasional large winners to offset more frequent small losers (emotionally difficult)
The 5-minute opening range breakout gives a delayed entry; by the time the breakout is confirmed, 30-40% of the continuation move may already be done
On days where initial momentum is due to a single large block trade (not genuine flow), the continuation fails and reverses sharply, hitting stops
prior_art: Katz & McCormick (2000) gap and go; Clenow (2014) momentum strategies. Similar to Bulkowski (2005) gap continuation patterns in Technical Analysis.
notes: Edge math: 0.52 * 70bps - 0.48 * 30bps = 36.4 - 14.4 = 22bps gross. Costs ~9bps RT. Net ~13bps/trade * 2 trades = ~26bps daily. The edge is in the asymmetry: winners are 1.6x losers. Strict time filter (morning only) is critical — afternoon gap continuation is unprofitable.
